records.eventYearNote: World Vegan Day is observed on November 1.
records.title: World Vegan Day
records.claim: World Vegan Day is a day to learn about plant-based foods and caring for animals.

records.title: The first International Space Station crew moves in
records.claim: The first long-term crew of three astronauts moved into the International Space Station in 2000.

records.title: Laika travels into space
records.claim: Sputnik 2 carried Laika, a dog, into orbit around Earth.

records.title: Tutankhamun's tomb is found
records.claim: Archaeologist Howard Carter discovered the entrance to Tutankhamun's tomb.

records.eventYearNote: The Monopoly patent was issued in 1935; November 5 is the requested worksheet date.
records.title: The Monopoly board game is patented
records.claim: The Monopoly board game uses spaces, money, and properties for players to manage.

records.eventYearNote: James Naismith invented basketball in 1891; November 6 is the requested worksheet date.
records.title: Basketball is invented
records.claim: James Naismith invented basketball as an indoor game with a ball and elevated goals.

records.title: Marie Curie is born
records.claim: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw and became a pioneering scientist who studied radioactivity.

records.title: X-rays are discovered
records.claim: Wilhelm Rontgen noticed invisible rays that could pass through some materials, including human tissue.

records.title: The Berlin Wall opens
records.claim: People began crossing through the Berlin Wall after East Germany announced that its border crossings would open.

records.title: Sesame Street begins
records.claim: Sesame Street premiered and began teaching letters, numbers, and ideas through stories and songs.

records.eventYearNote: World Origami Day is observed on November 11.
records.title: World Origami Day
records.claim: World Origami Day celebrates folding paper into shapes such as cranes and dragons.

records.title: Philae lands on a comet
records.claim: The Philae lander became the first spacecraft to make a soft landing on a comet.

records.eventYearNote: World Kindness Day is observed on November 13.
records.title: World Kindness Day
records.claim: World Kindness Day encourages people to help others and perform thoughtful acts.

records.eventYearNote: Insulin was discovered in 1921; November 14 is World Diabetes Day.
records.title: World Diabetes Day and insulin
records.claim: World Diabetes Day helps people learn about diabetes, and insulin changed its treatment.

records.eventYearNote: Intel introduced the 4004 in November 1971; November 15 is the requested worksheet date.
records.title: A tiny computer processor
records.claim: Intel introduced the 4004, an early commercial microprocessor on one small chip.

records.title: UNESCO is founded
records.claim: UNESCO was founded to build peace through cooperation in education, science, and culture.

records.title: The Suez Canal opens
records.claim: The Suez Canal opened and created a shorter water route between the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea.

records.title: Mickey Mouse appears with sound
records.claim: Steamboat Willie premiered and helped make Mickey Mouse famous with synchronized sound.

records.title: The Gettysburg Address
records.claim: Abraham Lincoln gave a short speech at a cemetery dedication for soldiers who died at Gettysburg.

records.title: World Children's Day
records.claim: World Children's Day highlights children's rights, including the right to learn, grow, and be protected.

records.eventYearNote: World Television Day is observed on November 21.
records.title: World Television Day
records.claim: World Television Day recognizes how television shares information, stories, and ideas.

records.title: Toy Story premieres
records.claim: Toy Story premiered as the first feature-length computer-animated film.

records.eventYearNote: Fibonacci Day is observed on November 23 because 11/23 begins 1, 1, 2, 3.
records.title: Fibonacci Day
records.claim: Fibonacci Day celebrates a sequence in which each number comes from adding the two before it.

records.title: Darwin explains evolution
records.claim: Charles Darwin published On the Origin of Species, explaining how living things change over generations.

records.eventYearNote: Alfred Nobel's inventions and patents date from the 1890s; November 25 is the requested worksheet date.
records.title: Nobel's inventions and patents
records.claim: Alfred Nobel used science and engineering to create inventions and received patents for some of his work.

records.eventYearNote: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland was published in 1865; November 26 is the requested worksheet date.
records.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
records.claim: Lewis Carroll's story follows Alice as she meets unusual characters and explores a surprising world.

records.title: The Nobel will is signed
records.claim: Alfred Nobel signed a will that used much of his fortune to create prizes for important work.

records.title: Magellan's fleet enters the Pacific
records.claim: After sailing through a passage at South America's southern end, Magellan's fleet entered the Pacific Ocean.

records.title: Pong is released
records.claim: Atari released Pong, a simple electronic table-tennis game that helped launch video games.

records.title: Mark Twain is born
records.claim: Samuel Clemens, who wrote as Mark Twain, was born in Missouri and later wrote Tom Sawyer.
